notes: Finding F5 (::before/::after and CSS border triangles, docs/engine/fidelity/01-FINDINGS.md): a timeline whose
axis and numbered dots are pseudo-elements (counter(ms)), a flow of boxes with zero-size border-triangle
arrows and an ::after arrow, clip-path chevrons beside ::after-tipped ones, a colour edge made three ways
(border-left, ::before, inset box-shadow) and ::before bullet dots. The paint package (E) rebuilds each
materialised pseudo-element as a real element (14-WPE's pre-pass) and draws a triangle as its exact join
polygon. The HTML is the probe's but for one line: the heading has width:872px, to layout-06's title zone's
right edge (see flexgrid's notes; here the probe's title overhung by 4 px through the test masters'
manifest/theme mismatch).
13 pseudo-elements are painted and 13 are rebuilt, 0 dropped (the info diagnostic pins it): .tl::before 1,
.ms::before 4, .box.arrow::after 1, .chev2::after 3, .e2::before 1, .bl div::before 3.
Counts follow master brief 11 as amended by B, with E's grouping rule (14-WPE: a materialised pseudo is a
real child; an out-of-flow one never splits the paragraph run it sits in):
text 26 = title 1 + timeline 12 + flow 4 + chevrons 6 + edges 2 + bullets 1:
timeline: per .ms the in-flow '.yr' year (1 element; it starts after its 34 px padding), the ::before
counter's number (its own element, centred, over its circle: content:counter(ms) with a fill) and the
absolutely positioned '.d' description (an out-of-flow block starts its own element) = 3 x 4;
flow: the four boxes' centred labels, 4; chevrons: the three clip-path .chev labels and the three .chev2

run: 11's 'an in-flow positioned (relative) block between two others intervenes' is about a relative
sibling that is not part of the run (page.js interrupted()); these three are the run, as paint's three
relative .step counters are one element of three paragraphs.
